_notes.visa_address: VXI-11 format: TCPIP0::<ip>::inst0::INSTR. Replace IP as needed.
_notes.channel: C1..C4 (single module) or C1..C16 (MCM with multiple modules). Ignored when math_enable=true (acquisition/export uses math_channel instead).
_notes.channel_coupling: D50 = DC 50 ohm | D1M = DC 1 Mohm | A1M = AC 1 Mohm | GND.
_notes.channel_scale_v: Vertical scale in V/div (8 divisions -> full window = 8 x scale). When math_enable=true, also applied to math_source1/2.
_notes.amplitude_window_v: Total vertical amplitude window in V (= 8 divisions). If set (non-null), overrides channel_scale_v.
_notes.sample_rate_sps: 8.0e10 = 80 GSa/s. Forced via Maximize='FixedSampleRate'. 80 GSa/s requires <= 2 active channels (interleaved ADCs) — math_source1+math_source2 already = 2.
_notes.acquire_points: Samples to acquire and export. 0 = don't constrain memory, export all acquired points.
_notes.trigger_source: e.g. 'C1'. null = leave the scope's current trigger source. When math_enable=true, keep this on a real channel (e.g. math_source1 or math_source2) — math traces are not valid trigger sources.
_notes.channels: Optional list of raw channels to acquire together from ONE trigger event, e.g. ["C3", "C4"] — ignored if math_enable=true. When set, each channel is saved to its own CSV (output filename gets a _C<n> suffix), instead of the single `channel`.
_notes.force_trigger: true = software-force a trigger if none arrives within acquisition_timeout_s.
_notes.default_setup: true = recall factory default setup during initialize.
_notes.math_enable: true = acquire/export a math function trace (e.g. a channel difference) instead of a single raw channel.
_notes.math_operator: MAUI Operator1 value: 'Difference' gives math_channel = math_source1 - math_source2 (confirmed on the front-panel Math dialog; 'Subtract' is not a valid value). Other operators (Sum, Product, Ratio, ...) unconfirmed.
_notes.math_scale_v: V/div for the math trace. null (default) = don't touch it — F1's vertical scale is derived from channel_scale_v on this firmware and there's no confirmed scriptable VerScale for a math trace (app.Math.F1[.View/.Out].VerScale are all unsupported here).
_notes.math_amplitude_window_v: Total vertical window (V) for the math trace, overrides math_scale_v if set. Same caveat as math_scale_v — leave null unless a working CVAR path is found.
_notes.math_offset_v: Vertical offset (V) for the math trace.
_notes.math_hide_sources: true = hide math_source1/2 traces on the grid once the math trace is set up, so only math_channel is displayed. Trigger/math computation still work on hidden channels.
_notes.math_save_sources: true = when math_enable is true, also export the two raw source channels (math_source1, math_source2) as their own CSVs alongside the math trace — 3 files per run, all from the same acquisition (output filename gets a _<channel> suffix, e.g. run_F1.csv, run_C3.csv, run_C4.csv).
